messages:
maria: Heads up — aps4a rack19 node-47 just started showing an ECC-corrected error spike + fan RPM drop. I'm initiating a drain; seeing batch-queue backpressure already.
ops-bot: [alert] node-47: ECC corrected=128 in last 10m; fan_sensor rpm down 17%. Auto-drain triggered.
aj: Oncall here. Which pools are impacted? Is autoscaler kicking in or stuck?
maria: Batch pool 'triton-batch-aps4a' lost ~30% capacity. Autoscaler isn't scaling — reserved capacity limit hit for this account. I'm preparing to shift some queued work to fallbacks.
sam: Can we shift to aps2 instead of eu-west? Latency-sensitive jobs need <200ms.
maria: aps2 is ~90% utilized. Plan: latency jobs -> eu-west (short-term); throughput jobs -> aps2. I'll change routing policy rules to split 60/40.
jin: Starting drain command: `fleetctl drain node-47 --reason "ECC+fan" --safe-evict` — monitoring evictions.
maria: Thanks. Also allocating a hot-spare: spare node-13 warming for aps4a batch pool. ETA ~7m to load kernels/models.
aj: Add a canary traffic slice first, move 5% of queued jobs only. Watch `tail -f /var/log/triton/*.log` and `dmesg` for OOMs or kernel errors.
maria: Canary applied, 5% traffic moved to spare. No errors in logs so far.
natalie: Heads-up on cost — cross-region moves to eu-west increase egress + infra cost ~1.8x. If we stay >2h, finance escalation required.
sam: Hardware side — node-47 shows intermittent PSU voltage dips and a few mem-corrected spikes. I've filed vendor RMA #98234. ETA 48h for replacement.
maria: Plan: finish draining, bring spare node-13 fully online, mark node-47 as pending-RMA in inventory, update routing policy back when healthy, and track cost exposure.
aj: If drain stalls, ping me. Also remember cache warmers — moving models cold will spike token/time costs.
maria: Noted. Runbook checklist in thread: drain -> healthcheck -> monitor queue & autoscaler -> mark RMA -> follow-up.
ops-bot: [info] drain complete for node-47 at ts=1955557002. spare node-13 joined pool and reported ready.
maria: Drain confirmed. Batch queue backlog down ~28%, canary latency looks normal. Reverting larger-scale shifts over next 10m.
natalie: :eyes: I'll kickoff cost watch and loop in finance if cross-region traffic persists beyond 2h.
sam: I'll schedule RMA pickup with the datacenter team. Leaving node-47 in quarantine role until vendor collects.
aj: Good job. After RMA, let's run a burn test on the replacement before returning to normal rotation.
maria: Will do. Posting a short incident summary once RMA is scheduled and cost impact tracked. Thanks everyone.
